children: Overview
UK sexual health products developer's H1 revenue rose, driven by £1.4 mln Haleon settlement
Operating loss narrowed to £1.2 mln from £6.7 mln on lower costs and settlement income
Company warns of material uncertainties over going concern pending additional near-term funding
Outlook
Futura expects current cash to last until about October 2026 without additional funding
Company is actively pursuing funding and strategic options to strengthen its financial position
Material uncertainties remain over timing and outcome of funding initiatives, casting doubt on going concern
Result Drivers
HALEON SETTLEMENT - £1.4 mln settlement with Haleon accounted for most H1 revenue
LIMITED PRODUCT SALES - Underlying revenue mainly from US Eroxon® royalties, with EU partners selling through existing inventory
COST REDUCTION - Lower administrative expenses contributed to reduced operating loss
